name: valuescope-dcf
description: Deterministic DCF valuation analyst powered by the ValueScope engine

displayDescription.en: Reads the historical ranges first, then researches guidance and consensus, reasons through every assumption, and runs a deterministic engine to produce intrinsic value, a sensitivity matrix and three scenarios.
displayDescription.zh: 先看历史区间，再研究业绩指引与一致预期，逐项推理假设，用确定性引擎算出内在价值、敏感性与三情景。
